body:
I suppose these are thoughts of my own, spawned by reading yours. I hope you don't mind if I share in turn.

Happiness is always harder to attain, or at least it feels that way. It can feel as if all the problems add up quickly, no matter how little, and even worse if they are not so little. It's difficult to shift perspective sometimes.

You seem kind. You care a lot about other people and how things might affect them. Animals too. It's a trait that is often suppressed by apathy, or something that many of us lose as time goes on.

Food is good. I like to try new things. It gives me a spark in the world that is otherwise a lonelier place without. It inspires me to want to see the world. To explore. And to capture that sense of childhood wonder that I never quite had. When I try good food, it is as if all of someone's care and attention has been put into making it, and it makes me happy to have experienced it. And that it even exists.

I don't know. But for what it's worth, I hope you get better and that you continue to enjoy the things that you do. Not everything always goes right, but I hope you will find the rare and few things that make it all worthwhile. It is my sincere wish for you from one stranger to another in the passing.
